contract: Preserve StudyFlow's existing CTU burgundy/navy/light-paper design. Use module names, prominent due dates, clear uploaded/completed states, functional planning links and restrained motion. Inspect desktop 1366x900, tablet 768x1024 and phone 360x800. No invented production statistics or new facilitator scope.

accessibility.evidence: Inspected visible labels and text alongside colour/status cues. Enter opened the mobile menu and activated navigation/profile save; modal and onboarding heading focus were observed. Reduced-motion override reviewed in CSS. These bounded checks do not certify WCAG or a complete screen-reader/OS reduced-motion audit.

responsive.evidence: Rendered desktop dashboard, tablet grades, phone assessments/settings/planner. DOM widths were 1366 at 1366 viewport, 753 at 768, and 345 at 360. No page-level horizontal overflow in these views. Phone planner selected-day control displayed the correct Thursday deadline and 75-minute saved budget.

loading.evidence: Full reload showed Loading your saved planner before server-confirmed data. Saves disabled controls while awaiting the server; no premature success was shown.

empty.evidence: Second approved account displayed an empty private planner with its own budgets and an Add an incomplete assessment link; no first-account task or timer total appeared.

error.evidence: Incorrect synthetic credentials displayed The email or password is incorrect. without exposing the first account. Error screenshot retained.

partial.evidence: Saved CTU source with one planned and one unplanned active assessment displayed distinct source/planner states and an uploaded review path. Grade rows retained a pending module while averaging only numeric Overall marks.

success.evidence: CTU plan and recurring class saved. Timer saved 31 seconds and survived reload. Uploaded assignment moved to completed with zero remaining work. Onboarding saved 165 minutes across three selected days.

permission.evidence: A verified synthetic account without approvedStudents membership displayed Student approval needed and no planner. Helper absence displayed installation instructions with Connect disabled. Only local emulator approval was changed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Synthetic saved CTU deadlines, matching planner links, module names, study budget and priority recommendation.
Tablet grade report controls, 81% unweighted numeric average and pending mark separation.
Phone CTU planning list and native assessment cards fit the viewport; controls and dates remain readable.
